statement: Pinned Linux hid-nintendo has separate commands for Switch Pro player indicators and HOME-button illumination. For right-capable controller types including Switch Pro, the kernel registers a distinct HOME LED class device with a 0 to 15 brightness domain and sends subcommand 0x38 with five payload bytes. If that initial 0x38 send fails, the kernel logs a warning and skips HOME LED registration without failing the probe. This establishes Linux consumer behavior, not measured retail brightness, fade, acknowledgement or LED hardware response.

applicability.revision: Linux kernel source revision 4056b3c; retail model and revision not measured
applicability.scope: Linux hid-nintendo.c lines 72-75, 659-678, 1030-1046, 2277-2293, 2356-2385, including 2373-2380 registration failure behavior; independent HOME-light LED class and its source command, not a physical-device test
